name: dan-video-studio
description: Dan's Video Studio — personal creative-process desktop app (idea to export). Phase 3: Prompt/Asset Lab.

scripts.dev:electron: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c blue,green "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
